comment: Worked out by hand (mitcad#1331): a released format-28 design has every change of format 28, so its two-sided extrude keeps `direction: negative`: the first distance (10) runs against the sketch normal and the second (5) along it, a 40 x 30 slab from z = -10 to z = 5 (40 * 30 * 15 = 18000). Upgraded again it would run from z = -5 to z = 10.
